nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable; set in constructor from msg.sender and changed in transferOwnership.
Mapping of token balances in StandardToken; debited/credited by transfer, transferFrom, freeze, unfreeze, mint and burn.
Nested allowance mapping in StandardToken; modified by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
totalSupply_ accounting variable; initialized in FindBitToken constructor and modified by mint and burn.
Pause flag guarding token transfers through the whenNotPaused modifier.
Mapping address => Schedule holding frozen token vesting data in FindBitToken.
Token name string, mutable by the owner through setTokenInfo.
Token symbol string, mutable by the owner through setTokenInfo.
Token decimals (18), used in the constructor supply computation.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function that transfers contract ownership to a new non-zero address.
ERC20 transfer; moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after balance checks.
ERC20 transferFrom; moves tokens from _from to _to using the caller allowance.
Sets the allowance of _spender for msg.sender.
Increases the caller allowance towards _spender.
Decreases the caller allowance towards _spender, flooring at zero via a local oldValue.
Owner-only function setting paused = true.
Owner-only function setting paused = false.
FindBitToken constructor: computes initial supply with a raw unchecked multiplication and assigns it to the deployer.
Owner-only function updating token name and symbol.
Freezes caller tokens into a vesting Schedule anchored at block.timestamp.
Owner-only function freezing tokens of _who with a cliff; writes the schedule under msg.sender instead of _who.
Releases vested tokens for _who using a timestamp-driven linear vesting computation.
Owner-only function minting new supply to _to.
Owner-only function burning _value tokens from _who.
External caller identity used for ownership checks, authorization and balance debits.
Block timestamp used as the vesting clock in freeze, freezeFrom and unfreeze.
Raw unchecked multiplication 50000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)) in the FindBitToken constructor (arithmetic risk).
freezeFrom stores the new Schedule under msg.sender rather than the target _who, misattributing frozen state to the owner account.
Division chain inside unfreeze computing the linear release amount from caller-controlled schedule fields.
Parameter _value of freeze: amount to freeze.
Parameter _duration of freeze: vesting duration in seconds.
Local variable timestamp in freeze assigned from block.timestamp.
Parameter _who of freezeFrom: account whose tokens are frozen.
Parameter _value of freezeFrom: amount to freeze.
Parameter _cliff of freezeFrom: cliff offset added to the start timestamp.
Parameter _duration of freezeFrom: vesting duration in seconds.
Local variable timestamp in freezeFrom assigned from block.timestamp.
Parameter _who of unfreeze: account whose schedule is released.
Storage pointer schedule = freezed[_who] inside unfreeze.
Local variable timestamp in unfreeze assigned from block.timestamp.
Local variable unreleased holding the computed vested amount in unfreeze.
Parameter _to of mint: recipient of newly minted tokens.
Parameter _value of mint: amount minted.
Parameter _who of burn: account whose tokens are destroyed.
Parameter _value of burn: amount burned.
Parameter _name of setTokenInfo.
Parameter _symbol of setTokenInfo.
Parameter _to of transfer: recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer: amount transferred.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.

edges.reason: Constructor takes the deployer identity from msg.sender to set the initial owner.
Ownable constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, comparing msg.sender to owner.
_newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with _newOwner.
setTokenInfo is restricted to the owner via msg.sender check.
_name parameter flows into the token name state variable.
_symbol parameter flows into the token symbol state variable.
setTokenInfo assigns _name to the name state variable.
setTokenInfo assigns _symbol to the symbol state variable.
freezeFrom is owner-only and additionally uses msg.sender as the schedule key.
_who parameter selects the balance to debit in freezeFrom.
_value parameter is the frozen amount in freezeFrom.
_cliff parameter is added to the start timestamp in freezeFrom.
_duration parameter sets the vesting length in freezeFrom.
Local timestamp derived from block.timestamp seeds the Schedule in freezeFrom.
freezeFrom builds the Schedule object that is misattributed to msg.sender.
The misattributed Schedule is persisted into the freezed mapping.
mint is owner-only, checked through msg.sender.
_to parameter receives the minted tokens.
_value parameter is added to totalSupply_ and to the recipient balance.
mint increases totalSupply_.
mint credits balances[_to].
burn is owner-only, checked through msg.sender.
_who parameter identifies the balance to burn from.
_value parameter is removed from balances[_who] and totalSupply_.
burn decreases totalSupply_.
burn debits balances[_who].
pause is owner-only and gated by whenNotPaused on msg.sender authorization.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
unpause is owner-only and gated by whenPaused on msg.sender authorization.
unpause sets the paused flag to false.
freeze anchors the vesting Schedule start, cliff and lastReleased on block.timestamp.
freezeFrom derives schedule timestamps from block.timestamp plus the cliff.
unfreeze compares and stores block.timestamp to decide the releasable amount.
freeze debits and freezes the caller's own msg.sender balance and schedule.
_value parameter becomes the frozen schedule amount in freeze.
_duration parameter becomes the vesting duration in freeze.
Local timestamp seeds start, cliff and lastReleased in freeze.
freeze stores the new Schedule under freezed[msg.sender].
freeze subtracts the frozen value from balances[msg.sender].
unfreeze is callable by anyone for an arbitrary _who, with no caller authorization.
_who parameter selects the freezed schedule and balance to credit.
Storage pointer schedule is mutated by unfreeze (amount, released, lastReleased).
Local timestamp from block.timestamp controls the release window checks.
unreleased carries the computed vesting amount produced by the arithmetic chain.
unfreeze performs the mul/div/sub vesting arithmetic represented by this node.
The arithmetic result (unreleased) is added to balances[_who].
unfreeze updates the stored Schedule for freezed[_who].
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
_to parameter receives the transferred value in transfer.
_value parameter is validated and moved between balances in transfer.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of msg.sender as the spender.
transferFrom updates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve sets the allowance in the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval reads and writes the caller's allowance in msg.sender context.
increaseApproval adds _addedValue to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval reads and writes the caller's allowance in msg.sender context.
decreaseApproval reduces allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor performs the raw 50000000 * 10**decimals multiplication.
decimals feeds the exponent of the initial supply computation.
The unchecked multiplication result becomes totalSupply_.
Constructor assigns totalSupply_ = 50000000 * 10**decimals.
Constructor allocates the whole supply to balances[deployer].
Constructor credits the initial supply to msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: _value is a plain parameter of freeze and only affects that function's state writes.
_duration is a plain parameter of freeze and only affects that function's vesting schedule.
timestamp is a freeze-local derived from block.timestamp.
_who is a plain parameter of freezeFrom selecting the debited balance.
_value is a plain parameter of freezeFrom supplying the frozen amount.
_cliff is a plain parameter of freezeFrom used for the cliff offset.
_duration is a plain parameter of freezeFrom setting the vesting length.
timestamp is a freezeFrom-local derived from block.timestamp.
_who is a plain parameter of unfreeze selecting the schedule to release.
schedule is a storage pointer local owned entirely by unfreeze.
timestamp is an unfreeze-local derived from block.timestamp.
unreleased is a local computed inside unfreeze and credited to balances.
_to is a plain parameter of mint used as the balance recipient.
_value is a plain parameter of mint used for supply and balance increments.
_who is a plain parameter of burn selecting the debited balance.
_value is a plain parameter of burn used for balance and supply decrements.
_name is a plain parameter of setTokenInfo written to the name state variable.
_symbol is a plain parameter of setTokenInfo written to the symbol state variable.
_to is a plain parameter of transfer used as the credited address.
_value is a plain parameter of transfer moved between balances.
_newOwner is a plain parameter of transferOwnership written to owner.
